title: Lumen Strikes Connectivity Deal With Amazon’s Cloud Unit. The Stock Jumps.
title_zh: Lumen 与亚马逊云部门达成连接协议。股票上涨。
summary: The networking company is working with Amazon Web Services to provide businesses cloud connectivity.
summary_zh: 该网络公司正在与亚马逊网络服务合作，为企业提供云连接。

title: Wealth management land grab drives deal boom amid private market upheaval
title_zh: 私人市场动荡之际，财富管理领域的抢地驱动交易热潮
summary: Carlyle CEO Harvey Schwartz. Patrick T. Fallon/Getty Images Wealth management firms are on the auction block, and they’re selling faster than ever.
summary_zh: 凯雷集团首席执行官哈维·施瓦茨。 Patrick T. Fallon/Getty Images 财富管理公司正在拍卖，而且它们的销售速度比以往任何时候都快。

title: Is KKR's (KKR) Samsung SDS Deal Quietly Rewiring Its Tech Exposure and Earnings Mix?
title_zh: KKR (KKR) 的三星 SDS 交易是否正在悄然重新调整其技术风险和盈利组合？
summary: In recent days, KKR-backed funds agreed to purchase KRW 1.22 trillion (about US$820 million) in newly issued convertible bonds from Samsung SDS, forming a partnership focused on AI transformation services, infrastructure, and global expansion support.
summary_zh: 近日，KKR 支持的基金同意从三星 SDS 购买 1.22 万亿韩元（约合 8.2 亿美元）新发行的可转换债券，形成专注于人工智能转型服务、基础设施和全球扩张支持的合作伙伴关系。

title: Stock Market Today, April 14: Oracle Jumps on Expanded Bloom Energy Deal
title_zh: 4 月 14 日今日股市：Oracle 因扩大 Bloom Energy 交易而股价上涨
summary: Today, April 14, 2026, investors are weighing a huge fuel-cell power partnership and new AI tools reshaping this cloud giant’s outlook.
summary_zh: 今天，2026 年 4 月 14 日，投资者正在权衡巨大的燃料电池电力合作伙伴关系和重塑这家云巨头前景的新人工智能工具。

title: Blackstone Eyes Stroer Deal As European Media Role Expands
title_zh: 随着欧洲媒体角色的扩大，黑石集团关注斯特罗尔交易
summary: Blackstone (NYSE:BX) is reportedly partnering with I Squared Capital to pursue the core advertising business of German media company Stroer.
summary_zh: 据报道，Blackstone（纽约证券交易所股票代码：BX）正在与 I Squared Capital 合作，开发德国媒体公司 Stroer 的核心广告业务。
